rules: Name 'Leonore no.1' is customary but not chronological (1807 is third Leonore overture)
Record 4695 source-guide documents the second version Op75 no2 only, NOT all Six Songs
Keep WoO127 first setting and Op75/2 later setting as two nodes with a version edge
Op94 An die Hoffnung is new setting distinct from Op32 original
WoO140a Excel raw is not a certified distinct work identity from WoO140 family
For 4630 and 4636 Beethoven is arranger/adaptor of pre-existing melodies, not author of folk tune
Collections WoO99, Op82, Op48, Op98 are source guide entities: do not fabricate unlinked individual members
Rate limited Flaminio pages Andenken and Der Wachtelschlag have independent authority only
